purpose: Controlled semantic views over existing agent records; not a production evaluator.

entity_types.definition: Existing repositories record; locator is an alias, not its identity.
Existing immutable repository state, including relevant dirty-tree content.
Existing immutable execution-environment manifest.
Existing content-addressed artifact record.
Checked repository-scoped file binding; spelling and case follow the repository provider.
Checked symbol binding with language, qualified name and containing file; overloads remain distinct.
A named package, module or service within an explicit repository/provider namespace.
One resolved dependency occurrence, including environment, resolver and lockfile path; not a package name alone.
One effective configuration key with a declared scalar type, nullability and resolution context.
One identified API/interface contract with a versioned signature binding.
An identified test with its definition digest and parameters in the execution context.
A specific operation and input/fixture case; references its input artifacts and execution context.
Existing immutable contract revision.
Stable requirement/criterion identifier within a contract family; evaluated against a concrete revision.
Existing applied patch candidate with exact base and result state.
Existing typed action proposal; describing it does not dispatch it.
Existing concrete execution attempt; retries have separate attempts.
Existing candidate assessment under a verification manifest and policy.
A coding or research procedure represented by an existing immutable memory revision.
Existing immutable question and resolution criteria.
Existing immutable memory revision, with its own lifecycle projection.
Existing excerpt anchored to a captured source snapshot.
Existing immutable event; event time and recorded time remain separate.
Existing immutable model deployment fingerprint.
A registered semantic concept; it never creates an external entity or grants a capability.

predicates.definition: The effective value of this configuration binding in the statement situation. Type and nullability come from the key definition.
predicates.evidence: Configuration inspection or authoritative configuration source; a normative frame instead describes a desired value.
predicates.negation: Explicit opposing assertion; absence of an edge is not negation.

predicates.definition: The version resolved for one dependency occurrence in its environment and resolver context.
predicates.evidence: Lockfile/resolver or installed dependency inspection with the binding identity.
predicates.negation: Explicit opposing assertion; absence of an edge is not negation.

predicates.definition: The file directly defines the symbol at the declared repository state.
predicates.evidence: Inspected source or language-tool output at the stated revision.
predicates.negation: Explicit opposing assertion; absence of an edge is not negation.

predicates.definition: The caller directly invokes the callee in the declared situation. Directness is not reachability.
predicates.evidence: Inspected call site or scoped trace; dynamic uncertainty is retained.
predicates.negation: Explicit opposing assertion; absence of an edge is not negation.

predicates.definition: A direct dependency from consumer to provider. This predicate is directional and not transitively closed.
predicates.evidence: Declared dependency or scoped implementation evidence.
predicates.negation: Explicit opposing assertion; absence of an edge is not negation.

predicates.definition: The component exposes the identified interface under the declared conditions.
predicates.evidence: Inspected exports, documented interface or qualified runtime inspection.
predicates.negation: Explicit opposing assertion; absence of an edge is not negation.

predicates.definition: The implementation claims conformance to the identified interface. Covered behavior and limitations remain attached.
predicates.evidence: Declaration or conformance evidence; a declaration alone is classified as a source report.
predicates.negation: Explicit opposing assertion; absence of an edge is not negation.

predicates.definition: The file has the specified byte digest in the exact repository state.
predicates.evidence: Repository/artifact service calculation; never a model-invented digest.
predicates.negation: Explicit opposing assertion; absence of an edge is not negation.

predicates.definition: The immutable artifact record has this verified content digest.
predicates.negation: Explicit opposing assertion; absence of an edge is not negation.

predicates.definition: One identified test occurrence had this classified result in one execution attempt.
predicates.evidence: Tool event and test report with exact state, environment and definition digest.
predicates.negation: Explicit opposing assertion; absence of an edge is not negation.

predicates.definition: The verification service assigned this result to this criterion in this assessment.
predicates.evidence: Existing assessment/manifest; semantic matching cannot create or upgrade it.
predicates.negation: Explicit opposing assertion; absence of an edge is not negation.

predicates.definition: The operation returned this scalar in the specific input/fixture case and stated situation. It makes no universal claim about other inputs.
predicates.evidence: Scoped execution observation or explicitly classified source report.
predicates.negation: Explicit opposing assertion; absence of an edge is not negation.

predicates.definition: The operation raised the identified error class in the specific case and situation.
predicates.evidence: Scoped execution/error evidence; no conclusion about every possible input.
predicates.negation: Explicit opposing assertion; absence of an edge is not negation.

predicates.definition: This run produced this artifact. Several runs can produce identical artifact content.
predicates.negation: Explicit opposing assertion; absence of an edge is not negation.

predicates.definition: The procedure is intended to address the registered problem concept; this is a relevance relation, not a success guarantee.
predicates.evidence: Procedure content and its supporting/contradicting episodes.
predicates.negation: Explicit opposing assertion; absence of an edge is not negation.

predicates.definition: The run has one measured aggregate for the metric under its declared accounting policy. Measurements from different policies are not merged.
predicates.evidence: Usage/measurement event with units and measurement policy; elapsed_time=s, peak_memory=B, token metrics=count.
predicates.negation: Explicit opposing assertion; absence of an edge is not negation.

metadata_relations.definition: Positive evidence assessment with coverage and interpretation class; does not imply independent corroboration.
Evidence against the claim under overlapping conditions; retains its own scope.
Limits coverage, adds an exception or identifies uncertainty; travels with the claim.
Checked lineage; acyclic derivation; participates in deletion.
Explicit recorded replacement of one revision; same applicable policy/ownership checks; not inferred from recency.
A scoped exception linked to the procedure/claim it limits.
Required supporting item/condition for using the target; traversal remains bounded.
Retrieval hint only; ordinary relatedness cycles are allowed.

guard_type_rules.eq_ne_in: Known operands must have the same declared type/domain as the field; entity types and IDs must match. No string, number or label coercion. Explicit null is allowed only for a nullable field.
guard_type_rules.ordered_comparisons: lt/le/gt/ge accept integer, decimal, timestamp or quantity fields of the same type and canonical unit only. Versions use version_satisfies.
guard_type_rules.missing_input: Uninspected, unavailable or conflicted inputs give unknown; authoritative absence makes present false, is_null false and value comparisons unknown.
guard_type_rules.known_null: present is true and is_null is true. eq(null,null) is true; comparisons follow the declared nullable type.
guard_type_rules.normalization: Flatten nested identical all/any operators; sort and deduplicate canonical children; remove double not. Preserve all other nesting and operators. Do not apply classical excluded-middle or contradiction simplifications.

concepts.definition: Satisfying the specified behavior under stated conditions.
Compatibility with explicit interfaces, versions or environments.
Measured compute, memory, latency or budget use.
A scoped user or project preference.
Distinguish plausible causes of an observed symptom.
Find exceptions, contradictions or disconfirming observations.
Obtain evidence for an acceptance criterion.
A defect attributable to the candidate implementation.
Evidence contradicts the tested technical hypothesis.
Required work or evidence is unfinished.
The environment or execution infrastructure prevented a valid assessment.
Observed instability under a declared repetition policy.

functional_conflict_rule: Positive unequal values of a declared functional slot identify candidate incompatibility only. Factual conflict additionally requires compatible factual interpretation and proven overlapping situation. Normative classification uses effective binding and the force/polarity rules below, not identical source-authority categories. Negative values are exclusions, not alternate settings.

normative_compatibility.must_must: Incompatible simultaneously effective binding obligations are a normative conflict, including when their authoritative sources differ.
normative_compatibility.may_may: Alternative permissions are compatible and do not demand that both alternatives occur.
normative_compatibility.must_may: Flag permission_prohibition_tension only for an explicitly effective permission opposed by an effective prohibition; authoritative policy resolves any priority or exception. Permission is not an obligation or an execution capability.
normative_compatibility.should_should: Opposing recommendations are recommendation_tension, not an unsatisfiable binding-obligation verdict.
normative_compatibility.prefer_prefer: Opposing preferences are preference_tension; existing selection policy governs their use.

concept_binding: Resolve vocabulary release plus stable concept identifier to a checked registered concept entity UUID; display labels do not determine that UUID.
target_field_resolution: Resolve selected dependency/file/interface/configuration logical locators in the target repository state and environment. Never satisfy a target guard by rereading only the immutable source binding. Missing or ambiguous mapping gives unknown.
valid_time_rules: Intervals are half-open. A null endpoint explicitly means unbounded; both endpoints null are rejected in favor of scope_only. Unknown time uses kind unknown. Event and recorded times remain existing provenance fields.
versioning: Stable IDs never change definition. Changes publish immutable releases and new compatible or migrated representations. Old coordinates are never reused.
